g.text: Computed from the published fit L = E + A/N^α + B/D^β (E = 1.69, A = 406.4, B = 410.7, α = 0.34, β = 0.28; Hoffmann et al. 2022) for language models;
training compute C ≈ 6ND floating-point operations (dashed lines in a: equal compute). Constants differ for other data types and architectures.
